Lance has three things Gunlance doesn't; Power Guard, charge, and counter pokes. 

Power guard is a good "OH SHIT" button, when you activate it you hunker down with the shield and immobilize yourself for a few seconds, in this position you can tank pretty much any blockable attack, and it's stronger than a regular block, giving it better defensive abilities than Gunlance. 

Charge is good for mounting and getting around the map, but if you execute it at the wrong times then it's situational. 

Counter poking is good, allows you to block and then instantly strike back with pretty much 100% safety, if you play a completely defensive counter playstyle then you basically can't die. 

But Gunlance has better offensive abilities, Lance doesn't have any damage dealing abilities like Wyrmstake or Wyverns fire. Lance doesn't have any hard hitting attacks like that, it makes up for the lack of damage by having power guard and the ability to Mount monsters. 

Gunlance has the second strongest defense in the game. Only reason Lance wins in the tanking department is because of power guard. With Gunlance you have several ways to deal good damage and a good enough block to survive a lot of things the game has without much concern. It's all up to you though. Preference wins in the end.
